intro: Modern in design and rich in function, our Upmods table keeps your night-time essentials nearby—styled to complement any Upmods bed.

features.title: Two-tier storage system
features.text: Offers an open shelf for quick-grab items and a drawer to tuck things away—ideal for books, gadgets, or skincare.

features.title: Built to last, beautifully
features.text: Combines high-quality PU fronts with durable PLT structure, promising strength that lasts and looks that please.

features.title: Space-smart form
features.text: It’s compact enough for tighter bedrooms, yet thoughtfully designed to offer maximum utility in minimum space.

features.title: Subtle, modern tones
features.text: A soft beige with brown base gives this piece a cozy, neutral character that blends easily into your bedroom palette.

features.title: Quick and simple assembly
features.text: Minimal parts, no fuss—easy to assemble and just as easy to reposition when refreshing your bedroom setup.

name: Upmods Prelaminated Particle Board Bedside Table
